text:
alex_ae: Heads-up: ClearLedger wants a 1-week BYO-HSM POC. Requirements: customer-managed, non-exportable keys, rotation every 14 days, and signed rotation artifacts pushed to their compliance webhook. They want to validate perf at ~350 rps peaks. Need quick feasibility + pricing options. cc @ashish_se @lina_security

ashish_se: Feasible. Need vendor PKCS#11 module (or KMIP) and a test admin account. Two integration modes: proxy->HSM over mTLS or customer-side partial-sign aggregation. Which do they prefer?

alex_ae: They prefer proxy-first (no inbound), PKCS#11, and insist on notarized attestation only for production. For POC they accept internal attestation + signed logs.

lina_security: POC checklist: HSM model + FIPS certs, vendor module hash, IP allowlist, custodian contact, and proof format spec for their webhook. Blocker: we must ensure no plaintext key material is logged. We'll add CI grep rules.

sam_sre: For 350 rps bursts we'll size 2 proxy nodes in staging and run a perf sweep. Deliverables: runbook, attestation doc (internal), perf report, and a signed-rotation example. Example rotation log we'll send:

2026-04-15T09:02:01Z INFO rotation key_id=cl-01 rotated_by=customer proof_digest=sha256:abc123

ashish_se: Sample curl for POC (proxy mode):

curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood.local/sign
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer pctoken'
  -d '{"key_id":"cl-01","payload":"...base64..."}'

Proxy forwards request to customer HSM via mTLS and returns signature blob. We'll capture latency and attach trace ids.

deploy_bot: staging-proxy deployed to staging-us-east at 2026-04-14T22:18Z :rocket:

alex_ae: Procurement asks pricing: flat POC fee vs per-sign? They want predictable cost.

sam_sre: Recommend: (A) small flat POC fee covering onboarding + 2 dry-runs, (B) production: reserved throughput monthly + optional per-1M ops overage, (C) notarized attestation as add-on. For negotiation offer a limited-time waiving of onboarding fee if commit to 6mo reserved tier.

lina_security: For the security questionnaire we'll provide a sample runbook snippet showing no-export flow and audit capture. I'll draft answers and attach to SOW.

alex_ae: Action items: I'll collect vendor .so and IP allowlist today. @ashish_se please prepare ephemeral cert rotation docs. @sam_sre will prepare perf test plan. I'll share SOW draft by EOD.

ashish_se: Ack. One note: if their PKCS#11 library requires root privileges on our proxy container, we'll need a privileged staging task or a vendor shim. Could be a minor blocker for staging.

alex_ae: I'll ask about container requirements. Thanks team :thumbsup:
